title: Father Abraham
transcription:
Father Abraham
Action song

Father Abraham had seven sons,
Seven sons had Father Abraham,
First he laughed ha ha!
Then he cried boo hoo!
All he did was go like this with a left
(arm)

(right [arm], left [foot], right [foot],
and the hips, turn around)
